verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe fetched an unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /openapi/mesh-api.json that covers customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional paths such as /openapi.json do not contradict this, because the spec lives at a different documented URL. missing for 10: spec not discoverable at standard well-known/conventional paths (e.g. /openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema
Observed unauthenticated documentation GET HTTP 200; parsed OpenAPI 3.0.3. The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
